current_use: active default tone0 for wall/street/oathway and matching fallback tags

native_generation_contract.source_scope: four separate full edge-to-edge stone materials, no silhouettes or empty margins
native_generation_contract.nominal_horizontal_stone_count: approximately10-14 broad main stones across full source; not a precise pixel guarantee
native_generation_contract.rendering: broad matte low-contrast warm-gray/gray-brown planes; sparse olive moss, very few chips; no dense micrograin, bright central patch, dark outer border, perspective, side walls, road edge or painted geometry masks
native_generation_contract.raw_policy: save untouched generator bytes; no worker blur, offset, edge lock, paint, alpha cleanup or pre-crop
native_generation_contract.seam_policy: measure periodic edge differences and repetition honestly; no natural seamlessness claim; parent owns authorized technical seam and world sampling integration
native_generation_contract.style_reference_role: approved coarse matte stone treatment/palette only; do not copy its larger4-stone scale or brick layout

exact_material_prompt: EXACT MATERIAL 0 / old-stone-1: irregular broad old rounded-polygon COBBLES, each distinct but tightly nested. Mostly medium-large gently worn convex stone faces, with a few medium infill stones, not a dense field of tiny round pebbles. Arrange an organic staggered non-grid pattern; no horizontal brick rows or rectangular slab grid. Thin earthy joints and only a few small subdued olive moss touches in some joints. Warm muted gray/taupe, very quiet face shading. Preserve this old-cobble identity while greatly simplifying the original busy texture.
